'''Joel Guillén García''' (born 28 August 2001) is an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[centre back]] for Spanish [[Tercera Federación]] club [[CD Binéfar]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Club career==
Born in [[Andorra la Vella]], Guillén was a youth player at [[FC Andorra]]. He then moved to Spain to play in the [[Primera Catalana]] for EFAC Almacelles, Atlètic Alpicat, [[CFJ Mollerussa]]  and [[UE Tàrrega]]. After one season with [[Atlético Monzón]] in the fifth-tier [[Tercera Federación]], playing alongside compatriots [[Izan Fernández]] and [[Márcio Vieira]], he moved in July 2023 to [[CD Binéfar]] in the same league and also in [[Aragon]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Joel Guillén fitxa pel Binèfar de Tercera RFEF|trans-title=Joel Guillén signs for Binéfar of the Tercera RFEF |url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/joel-guillen-fitxa-pel-binefar-de-tercera-rfef |access-date=23 March 2026 |work=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]] |date=12 July 2023 |language=Catalan}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Prosiguen los fichajes a menos de un mes de arrancar|trans-title=Signings continue with less than a month before start of season |url=https://www.diariodelaltoaragon.es/noticias/deportes/2022/07/11/prosiguen-los-fichajes-a-menos-de-un-mes-de-arrancar-1587163-daa.html |access-date=23 March 2026 |work=[[Diario del AltoAragón]] |date=11 July 2022 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

==International career==
Guillén was chosen for the Andorra under-16 team that won the UEFA Development Tournament in Malta in 2017. He scored in a 2–0 win over the host team as Andorra finished with two wins and a draw.<ref>{{cite news |title=La sub-16 venç en el Torneig desenvolupament UEFA a Malta|trans-title=Under-16 team win in the UEFA Development Tournament in Malta |url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/la-sub-16-venc-en-el-torneig-desenvolupament-uefa-a-malta |access-date=23 March 2026 |work=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]] |date=20 February 2017 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

In September 2022, Guillén was called up for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] for the first time by manager [[Koldo Álvarez]], ahead of [[UEFA Nations League]] matches away to [[Liechtenstein national football team|Liechtenstein]] and at home to [[Latvia national football team|Latvia]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Joel Guillén i Èric Vales, les novetats per a la Nations|trans-title=Joel Guillén and Èric Vales, new faces for the Nations League|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/joel-guillen-i-eric-vales-les-novetats-per-a-la-nations |access-date=23 March 2026 |work=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]] |date=21 September 2022 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He made his debut on 16 November that year, in a 1–0 [[Exhibition game|friendly]] loss to [[Austria national football team|Austria]] in [[Málaga]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Andorra aguanta l’empat molts minuts però acaba cedint al final contra Àustria|trans-title=Andorra hold on to a draw for many minutes but end up conceding at the end against Austria |url=https://elperiodic.ad/esports/andorra-aguanta-lempat-molts-minuts-pero-acaba-cedint-al-final-contra-austria/ |access-date=23 March 2026 |work=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]] |date=17 November 2022 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He was one of four Andorran debutants at the [[Estadio La Rosaleda]] that night, and the only one to play the full 90 minutes.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Álvarez |first1=Ivan |title=Els quatre de La Rosaleda|trans-title=The four of La Rosaleda|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/221118/els-quatre-rosaleda_114713.html |access-date=23 March 2026 |work=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |date=18 November 2022 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

On 11 October 2025, Andorra earned their first point of [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|2026 FIFA World Cup qualification]] with a 2–2 draw away to Latvia, though Guillén was [[Ejection (sports)|sent off]] in added time.<ref>{{cite news |title=La selecció suma un empat contra Letònia|trans-title=National team earn a draw against Latvia |url=https://cadenaser.com/andorra/2025/10/11/la-seleccio-suma-un-empat-contra-letonia-radio-ser-principat-d-andorra/ |access-date=23 March 2026 |publisher=[[Cadena SER]] |date=11 October 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref>
